source.title: Craft Resume 0.5.0 actual Retail per-session CSV exporter source
source.author: R4s0n3

notes: NEW code-level verification of an already identified capture lead, NOT a new measured player cohort. Public Export.lua writes session-level 'disenchants' and 'disenchant_materials', a separate aggregate 'outputs' table with kind/id/quality/role/scope/quantity, and a recent craft log with time, recipe, scope and aggregate counters; the exported per-operation log does NOT include source-at-disenchant input itemLink or each operation's material IDs/quantities. README explicitly states Retail loot events do not supply a reliable source-item link. README documents 1,000 recent craft operations per session and 200 finished retained sessions; those are storage limits, NOT cast counts. Per-operation zero-inclusive material histogram and actual ilvl/bonuses for 272246 still cannot be reconstructed from arbitrary mixed-item CSV. Potential future controlled one-source-item-per-session test with matching screenshot/captured itemLink and actual successful-operation verification, pending client validation and original user-permitted export. No cast/hit/zero/quantity fields promoted; no synthetic confidence.
lookingFor: Original completed cast output ledger for Miststalker's Wristbands 272246 scaled ilvl 305, Umbral Tin 237362, Refulgent Copper 237359, Brilliant Silver 237365, and Midnight milling with reliable source input and zero-inclusive per-operation output.

source.title: EzDisenchant 1.1.7 Retail history cap and CSV/TXT export release notes
source.author: xBambyQT

quote: Disenchant History now holds up to 500 entries per character
notes: NEW verified retention detail for earlier source lead: 1.1.7 supports 500 history entries per character, 10 per page, and CSV/TXT export; after full-history prompt is dismissed, newer entries replace oldest during same session. This is a storage capacity, NOT 500 measured disenchants or confirmed full outcomes. Publisher page gives no CSV/TXT columns, no released player export, and no demonstration of original input itemLink, ilvl/bonus/skill, one-to-one output rows, successful-cast denominator or zero-inclusive receipts. No measured drop claims imported. Do not conflate WoW Forever 1.60.1 with Retail 12.1.5.
